issues.title: List and Select Niche
issues.description:
## Overview
Identify, evaluate, and finalize the core creator niche for the channel and content brand.

## Key Focus Areas
- Brainstorm prospective creator niches (Tech / AI / Coding / Lifestyle / Education)
- Analyze audience demand, search volume, and market saturation
- Evaluate monetization opportunities (Sponsorships, digital products, courses, consulting)
- Define target audience persona, primary pain points, and value proposition

subtasks.title: Brainstorm top 5 content niche ideas
Analyze competitor channels & view velocity
Evaluate audience demographics and retention
Finalize chosen niche and define brand positioning statement

issues.title: Content Structure
issues.description:
## Overview
Design the fundamental content architecture, series formats, and publishing calendar.

## Key Focus Areas
- Establish video/post formats: short-form (Reels/Shorts/TikTok) vs long-form (YouTube)
- Structure hook templates (first 3-5 seconds), retention pacing, and call-to-actions (CTA)
- Define recurring content buckets (e.g. How-To, News/Trends, Deep Dives, Stories)
- Build publishing rhythm and production sprint schedule

subtasks.title: Define 3 primary content pillars / buckets
Outline standard 5-part video structure (Hook, Lead-in, Core Value, Payoff, CTA)
Create weekly content publishing calendar
Draft thumbnail and title formula guidelines

issues.title: AI Tools
issues.description:
## Overview
Research, benchmark, and curate the production AI stack for content creators.

## Key Tool Categories
- **Text & Scripting:** Claude 3.5 Sonnet, ChatGPT Plus, Perplexity
- **Image & Thumbnail Generation:** Midjourney v6, Flux.1, Stable Diffusion
- **Audio & Voice:** ElevenLabs, Suno, Udio, Descript
- **Video & Animation:** Runway Gen-3 Alpha, Luma Dream Machine, Kling AI, HeyGen
- **Editing & Automation:** CapCut, Premiere Pro AI tools, Opus Clip

subtasks.title: Audit leading AI creative platforms and pricing tiers
Benchmark voice generation realism and latency (ElevenLabs)
Test video generation platforms (Runway vs Luma vs Kling)
Assemble integrated content creation pipeline and tool matrix

issues.title: Prompts
issues.description:
## Epic Overview
Comprehensive prompt engineering system for content production across scriptwriting, voiceover audio generation, AI video synthesis, and character creation.

## Child Generation Modules
1. **Audio Generation (CH-5):** Voice cloning, ElevenLabs audio prompts, background music pacing, and sound design.
2. **Video Generation (CH-6):** Runway Gen-3, Luma Dream Machine, Sora, and Pika camera motion & lighting prompts.
3. **Script Generation (CH-7):** Claude & ChatGPT viral storytelling, retention hooks, and multi-scene scripts.
4. **Character Development (CH-8):** Midjourney & Flux consistent character seeds, styles, and prompt references.

subtasks.title: Standardize prompt repository and reusable system instructions
Develop Audio Generation prompting templates (CH-5)
Develop Video Generation camera and scene prompts (CH-6)
Develop Script Generation hooks and storytelling frameworks (CH-7)
Develop Character Development style seeds and consistent identity prompts (CH-8)

issues.title: Audio Generation
issues.description:
## Overview
Craft prompt formulas and workflow templates for AI voiceovers, sound effects (SFX), and ambient background music.

## Key Focus Areas
- Voice cloning setup and tone calibration (ElevenLabs)
- Emotion, inflection, and pacing prompt tags
- Royalty-free AI background music generation (Suno/Udio)
- Automated audio cleanup and mastering presets

subtasks.title: Select and calibrate custom creator voice model
Craft prompt guide for narrative tone, pacing, and pauses
Test background music prompts matching video energy levels
Create standardized audio export checklist

issues.title: Video Generation
issues.description:
## Overview
Develop camera motion, lighting, and cinematic prompts for text-to-video and image-to-video generation engines.

## Key Focus Areas
- Camera direction prompts (Pan, tilt, dolly zoom, aerial drone shots)
- Cinematic lighting keywords (Golden hour, volumetric rays, cyberpunk neon, studio softbox)
- Motion fidelity and artifact reduction techniques
- Storyboard image-to-video workflow optimization (Runway Gen-3, Luma, Kling)

subtasks.title: Build prompt cheat sheet for camera motion parameters
Test image-to-video continuity using keyframe references
Benchmark rendering times and resolution scaling
Catalog top 20 high-performing visual prompts

issues.title: Script Generation
issues.description:
## Overview
Formulate advanced LLM prompt chains to produce compelling, viral scripts with high viewer retention.

## Key Focus Areas
- Viral Hook Frameworks (Curiosity gap, contrarian statements, visual intrigue)
- Pacing blueprints: 30s Shorts vs 60s Reels vs 8-10min YouTube videos
- Script tone calibration: conversational, authoritative, and relatable
- Automated shot list and B-roll cue generation in markdown

subtasks.title: Design master system prompt for script drafting
Implement 10 proven hook formula prompt templates
Include automated timestamped B-roll suggestions
Test script generation across 3 sample topics

issues.title: Character Development
issues.description:
## Overview
Create consistent visual characters, digital avatars, and brand personas using image generation models.

## Key Focus Areas
- Character sheet creation (Front, side, 3/4 angle, expressions)
- Maintaining consistent faces and outfits across Midjourney / Flux using seeds and character reference (--cref)
- Digital avatar lip-sync setup (HeyGen / D-ID)
- Visual brand guidelines: wardrobe, signature color palette, and accessories

subtasks.title: Generate master character concept turnaround sheets
Lock consistent seed and style reference prompt parameters
Test character in 5 varied scene environments
Export character asset library for thumbnail and video assets
